content: {"rewrite": false, "reason": "The paragraph (KVG Art. 7 para. 5) contains the rule that the insurance relationship ends only after the new insurer has notified the old one of uninterrupted coverage. This condition is expressed as a full subordinate clause ('wenn ihm der neue Versicherer mitgeteilt hat, dass die betreffende Person bei ihm ohne Unterbrechung des Versicherungsschutzes versichert ist') and does not yield a short noun phrase (≤8 words) from the statute that can serve as a literal answer to an open question without overlapping key terms (e.g., 'Versicherer', 'Mitteilung', 'versichert') in the question. Other short literal answers in the paragraph (e.g., 'der bisherige Versicherer', 'den Schaden, insbesondere die Prämiendifferenz') pertain to different rules (duty to inform, liability for omitted notification), not the termination rule tested by the yes/no item. Therefore, no open short-answer question testing the same rule with a short literal answer is possible."}
